headline: Base Exchanges Mount Across Marban Hollow as Frontline Bloodshed Intensifies
war_summary: Since the previous dispatch, frontline instability has surged sharply across central and northern sectors, driven by relentless base contests in Marban Hollow, Palantine Berm, and Weathered Expanse. Marban Hollow erupted with eight fresh strongpoint turnovers at Checkpoint Bua alongside seventeen hundred casualties in the last two hours. Palantine Berm sustained continuous back-and-forth clashes, logging five additional base transitions across Vendett and Windburn Landing. In Weathered Expanse, six further exchanges around Crow's Nest and Wightwalk accompanied twenty-seven hundred recent losses. Secondary flare-ups accelerated in Stonecradle and Gutter, each posting three base transfers over the past two hours at The Dais, Trammel Pool, and Suojus, while Farranac Coast saw Transient Valley reduced to neutral territory. Although Linn of Mercy recorded no base flips in the latest two-hour span, casualty rates soared violently with over fifty-two hundred combined fallen. Meanwhile, sectors such as Morgens Crossing, Nevish Line, and Clahstra register surging casualty rates under intense pressure despite static redoubts.
